title: Implement Robust Request Body Parsing
description: This feature matters as it enables the framework to handle various request body formats, such as JSON, URL-encoded, and multipart/form-data, which is essential for building robust and versatile APIs. It will provide a flexible way to parse request bodies, allowing developers to easily access and manipulate the data. This will improve the overall performance and usability of the framework
acceptance: The feature is accepted when the framework can successfully parse request bodies in different formats and make the data available to route handlers
reason: This feature is technically justified as it fills a crucial gap in the framework's functionality, allowing it to compete with other popular Node.js frameworks and providing a better experience for developers building APIs
